problem: Personal finance tasks (moving money, trading, taxes) are manual; Gravy's AI agent automates them in the background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents acting on financial accounts need reliability, security and integrations; a local-first Mac app is reported.

defensibility.rationale: No moat evidenced; trust and regulation could matter later.

market_need_then: No independent demand evidence was retrieved; the only signal is the company's positioning of an AI agent that automates personal finance tasks.
outcome_analysis: Gravy is a Spring 2026 YC company with a two-person team and a CEO who co-founded KiranaKart, which became Zepto. Aggregators report a $500k pre-seed in June 2026 only; it is too early to assess an outcome.
